info.text:
Same $10,000. One bank pays you $1. Another pays $400.

As of September 2026, some big banks paid 0.01% APY on standard savings, while top online banks paid about 4%.
The FDIC national average was 0.39% in January 2026.
The gap: branch costs, plenty of deposits, and customers who don't shop around.

Sources: FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps, Bankrate, US News (Sept 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
